YOUTH-POPUP-20260914.claim: The national youth-shop trial guidance explicitly links idle street shops and public/shared commercial space with youth entrepreneurs for 1-3 week low-cost trials, while local Youth League bodies, streets, commercial operators and state-owned asset platforms coordinate sites, compliance, funding and a national project reserve.

AGRI-MECH-PLAN-202609.claim: The national 15th Five-Year agricultural mechanization plan calls for agricultural-machinery service organizations, production trusteeship and order-based operations, information technology for supply-demand matching, regional emergency-service centers and cross-region collaboration.

AGRI-PENGYANG-20260618.claim: Pengyang's 2026 program operates through qualified registered service organizations, contracts, tracked work records, subsidy settlement and government oversight; a planned local ordering app was dropped when conditions were immature, while service still runs through the regulated project system.

AGRI-PENGYANG-20260525.claim: Pengyang reports 18 selected service organizations, more than 1,700 medium/large agricultural machines and existing village/cooperative service structures, with third-party digital supervision and traceability.

CLOUD-WAREHOUSE-202609.claim: The National Digital Cloud Warehouse Enterprise Public Service Platform currently lists 7,429 cloud-warehouse companies, 15,938 ten-thousand square metres of leasable warehouse area and coverage of 287 cities, with map discovery and flexible rental/managed-service listings.

WUHAN-WASTE-20260711.claim: Wuhan's Wufeibao platform connects waste-generating enterprises, licensed disposal operators and transporters across industrial, hazardous, household and construction waste, with a trading hall, demand posting and intelligent matching; it reports 610 matched transactions, 1,081 enterprises served and more than RMB6.22M transaction value.

JIANGSU-PV-20260721.claim: Jiangsu's 2026-2030 distributed-PV plan explicitly targets idle rural/public rooftops, supports village-enterprise cooperation and rooftop leasing, and requires clear agreements covering use term, revenue allocation, roof repair and end-of-contract disposal.

SUZHOU-ENERGY-20260620.claim: Suzhou reports 87 energy-expense trusteeship projects worth about RMB1.6B and 152 public-institution PV projects totaling 70MW, using centralized asset control, bundled procurement, private capital and integrated energy-service contracts to exploit idle rooftops.
